description: This file defines the LeaveApplicationService class, which manages leave application processes including applying for leave, validating leave periods, handling leave entitlements, and dispatching leave-related events within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LeaveApplicationService
classes.description: Service class handling leave applications, including validating, processing, and dispatching leave requests within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: applyLeave
methods.description: Creates and submits a new leave application, performing validation checks and invoking save operations.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequest
methods.description: Persists the leave request and associated comments, and dispatches related leave events.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Determines the leave status based on whether the date is a weekend, holiday, or a working day, returning appropriate status codes.

methods.name: allowToExceedLeaveBalance
methods.description: Indicates whether exceeding the leave balance is permitted; defaults to false.

methods.name: getWorkflowItemForApplyAction
methods.description: Retrieves the workflow state machine item corresponding to the 'APPLY' action for leave requests.
